editionLabel: Catch Up Games / Pandasaurus 2024 English base game
firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose the first player. That player takes the opening turn, then play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: The rulebook gives no preferred random method or themed eligibility criterion.
The turn order continues clockwise until everyone has nine cards in front of them.
